coverage_notes: Section 7.7's indemnify, defend, and hold-harmless obligation is operative but cannot be represented faithfully with the fixed activity and object vocabulary.

The existing output_ai_disclosure anchor covers the express end-user disclosure duty in Section 8.1. The paragraph's allocation of responsibility for decisions based on Outputs and their consequences does not map faithfully to an available activity.

paragraph_audit.reason: Section 7.7 requires the licensee to indemnify, defend, and hold DeepSeek and specified related parties harmless for qualifying third-party claims. No available activity/object combination represents this indemnity obligation faithfully; it is not a Use permission.

The end-user disclosure requirement in Section 8.1 is covered by the existing output_ai_disclosure anchor. The paragraph also allocates responsibility for decisions or actions based on Outputs and their consequences; that responsibility allocation does not fit an available activity, so the paragraph has additional material outside the activity scope.
